Association of Omeprazole-Related Myopathy With Drug-Drug and Drug-Gene Interactions Involving CYP2C19 and CYP3A4: A Nested Case-Control Study. Omeprazole, a widely used proton pump inhibitor, has been associated with rare but serious adverse events such as myopathy. Previous research suggests that concurrent use of omeprazole with fluconazole, a potent cytochrome P450 (CYP) 2C19/3A4 inhibitor, may increase the risk of myopathy.
